//: Pinned Python stacks for this build. `wheels` is the Office/file set installed inside <resources>/python by scripts/bundle-python-runtime.mjs; `extraWheels` is the optional engineering stack installed beside the image (<app dir>/python-extras) by scripts/bundle-python-extras.mjs. Every entry is an exact wheel and its sha256, installed with --require-hashes so a substituted or truncated wheel fails the build instead of shipping. The two sets install independently, so a shared dependency appears in both and each set keeps the version its own constraints allow. `overlays` are the files no index can provide (the ZLG python-can backend), applied per `scope` after pip install. Refresh deliberately: bump a version here, run the bundle script, and commit the regenerated apps/desktop/resources/python/MANIFEST.json in the same change.

python.note: Full CPython install, not the embeddable distribution: the user layer installs wheels with `pip install --target`, which needs pip, sysconfig and a normal Lib/ layout.

wheels.name: pillow
wheels.why: python-pptx runtime dependency (Pillow >=3.3.2): without it pip resolves an unpinned Pillow and the hashed install fails

overlays.why: 周立功（ZLG）USBCAN 后端：本机维护的 python-can 补丁，不在任何索引上
把 zlg 后端注册进 python-can 的 BACKENDS
让 pip --target 目录像真正的 site 目录：pywin32 的 .pth 与 DLL 目录只在 site 目录生效
